gates.next: Tracked INT4 source built and ran in alpha67. Changed Radiance profile matched the hash-checked diagnostic alpha68 stage, passed real-app work, and is now pinned in the refreshed opt-in package with a read-only preflight PASS. Upstream source-license provenance remains unresolved for publication.
Real Qwen3.8 Q4 loaded and answered coherently on the alpha68 diagnostic profile in two guarded cold loads. This does not prove startup reliability.
Alpha68 with the changed profile returned four distinct expected HTTP-200 answers and four observed active slots; long-context capacity remains separately evidenced on alpha67.

Changed-profile alpha68 scoped input capacity passed: four simultaneous HTTP-200 requests, each 100194 cold input tokens, four active slots, 365.345 s client batch, and production recovery. One response reached the explicit 256-token output cap; complete four-answer quality remains separate.

Changed-profile alpha68 passed the exact two-agent 64K+2K tool fixture in 128.559 s, 63840 cached tokens per continuation and 442 generated tokens. Cold-pair aggregate PP was about 1360.2 and generation ranged 7.448-9.770 TPS; the original 2000 PP target was not met. Prior alpha68 was 128.786 s with 442 generated; 0.227 s is one-run noise. BF16/R4D median was 133.684 s with 1183 generated, so task time does not isolate compute speed.

Changed-profile alpha68 two-agent 64K exact tasks passed with 63840 cached tokens per continuation; its frozen 100K tool-quality case passed exact checks in 99.072 s with 100320 cached tokens and no output cap. Four simultaneous alpha68 100K inputs completed, but one answer reached the explicit 256-token cap; four complete long answers and broader repeated quality remain unverified.

Same alpha68 executable and R9700 process-dedicated Windows counter measured Q4 idle 27559.316 MiB versus Vulkan idle 26914.594 MiB, +644.722 MiB (+2.4%). Seven Q4 four-active-100194-token samples were 28704.840 MiB. A guarded Vulkan four-active-near-100K run logged 99831 reserved context positions per request and yielded 71 dedicated samples at 27459.492-27459.496 MiB; observed Q4 active memory was about 1245.3 MiB (+4.54%) higher. All four Vulkan requests timed out after 720 seconds, so no completed matched workload, prompt usage, generation rate or true VRAM peak was measured. Keep IN_PROGRESS; do not claim full parity or a completed Vulkan speed comparison.

Scoped 20-cycle/120-mixed-request real-app Q4/Vulkan stress and original-production recovery passed independent audit. The outer runner recorded a false FAIL from a null child ExitCode; raw FAIL and audit are both retained, and the runner condition is fixed for future use. Earlier intermittent tokenizers.pyd 0xc0000005 did not recur during 20 Q4 reloads but is not explained; process-dedicated VRAM drift through the cycles was not captured. Keep this broad gate IN_PROGRESS until live activation/rollback and remaining stability evidence.

Alpha68 builds cleanly and 148/148 C++ checks pass; changed Python profile passed 43/43 focused tests, real 64K/100K loops and a scoped 20-cycle/120-request Q4/Vulkan reliability run. The opt-in package pins that exact profile; read-only preflight passed again after production recovery with production unchanged. The intermittent tokenizers.pyd cold-load crash remains unexplained. Production executable/active-config replacement and live rollback remain untested and require explicit authorization.
